title: North Shore Charters
specs: Tours explore the rugged Na Pali Coast and may include sea caves and snorkeling at Nualolo Kai
Passengers must be able to climb stairs to board the boat without assistance
Weight limit 280 lbs per person or seat; guests exceeding must purchase additional seat
Non-swimmers not permitted to enter the water
Guests with conditions requiring medication must bring medication on board
Maximum capacity per tour is 18 passengers
Private charters available with flat rate up to 16 passengers; 17th and 18th passenger possible for additional fee

services.name: NaPali Coast Boat Tours
services.desc: We specialize in offering quality boat tours of the Na Pali Coast. We offer tours aboard Anini I, a state of the art, custom built, 32 foot catamaran. Anini I is one of the largest commercial vessels on the north shore, yet we take the least number of passengers per tour to enhance our guests’ comfort and safety while

blurb: Guests explore the Na Pali Coast by boat with sightseeing and snorkeling opportunities. Tours include a complimentary lunch, soft drinks, and bottled water. Tours are approximately 4 hours and may include sea cave entry and snorkeling at Nualolo Kai depending on conditions.
extraNote: Private charters require 96 hours notice for 95% refund · No charge if operator cancels due to ocean conditions or unforeseen circumstances · 10% gratuity added to private and custom charters · Payment required at reservation; balance charged 48-96 hours prior to tour · Cancellation or changes must be called in; voicemail does not confirm changes · 4270-G Kilauea Road, Kilauea
